evidence.text: The entry reports Shuowen’s account that a graph identified as an ancient form of 鳳 was pictographic and came to be used for 朋黨 because the phoenix was followed by many birds. The dictionary also says the seal-script shape is an ancient form of 鳳 and that the regular-script form is written like two side-by-side 月 shapes. This records Shuowen’s historical explanation; it does not establish that the distinct early 朋 graph for the valuables unit descended from the phoenix graph.
